LogCycleCSV.pgx emits four RAIV/CSV lines per cycle. They are stitched back together on <seq>; a row is only kept if all four survived. All 17 did.

Blank = the build that produced that backup did not have the global at all, or the .dtx carries only the shipped default rather than a measurement. n/a = the figure is undefined for that row, e.g. a per-cycle delta on the first row.

column1: The two data sources measure different runs
